sentences.text: Eric Banadinović -LRB- born 9 August 1968 -RRB- , known professionally as Eric Bana , is an Australian actor and comedian .

He began his career in the sketch comedy series Full Frontal before gaining critical recognition in the biographical crime film Chopper -LRB- 2000 -RRB- .	sketch comedy	sketch comedy	Full Frontal	Full Frontal (Australian TV series)	Chopper	Chopper (film)
